objective: Recover the sole missing generic route without losing c1j's complete table, source, and recursive-manager routing.

causal_basis.finding: The matched-interface screen scored 8/10 root and 4/4 manager, with only generic at 0/2. Generic token groups showed valid wrong identities receiving positive advantage from the transport bonus even when no route was correct.

reward_correction.reason: A valid wrong identity must never outrank an invalid response when no sampled route is correct.

decision_rule.if_screen_passes: Retain c1l as an isolated router candidate and integrate the compact natural-JSON split scaffold for live end-to-end population evaluation.
decision_rule.if_screen_fails: Reject c1l without replacing e33 and stop this router lineage for architectural diagnosis.
decision_rule.promotion_requires: A later live end-to-end population evaluation with at least four complete qualifying trajectories.
